landing.heroSubtitle: Enterprise-grade, local-first intelligent Q&A engine with multi-agent orchestration, hybrid retrieval, graph enhancement, and streaming chat.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Full-stack enterprise architecture spanning multimodal ingestion, hybrid RAG, multi-agent reflection, MCP tool governance, and zero-trust security.
landing.feature1Desc: Built on LangGraph. Intelligently routes queries across Router, Vector RAG, Graph RAG, Web Research, and Synthesis nodes with stateful control.
landing.feature2Desc: Blends dense ChromaDB embeddings with sparse BM25 keyword search using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), followed by BGE Cross-Encoder reranking.
landing.feature3Desc: Queries Neo4j knowledge graphs to match entities and traverse multi-hop relationships, providing topological context for complex relational Q&A.
landing.feature4Desc: Decomposes complex multi-part queries into parallel sub-queries; uses a Verifier node for grounding evaluation and self-correction reflection.
landing.feature5Desc: Streaming PDF ingestion with chunk overlap parsing, integrated dual-language Tesseract OCR engine, and multimodal image captioning.
landing.feature6Desc: Standardized connector framework to sync external databases, APIs, and enterprise knowledge sources with incremental scheduling.
landing.feature7Desc: Monitors and balances token budgets with sliding window truncation, semantic summarization, and relevance-weighted context packing.
landing.feature8Desc: Standardized Anthropic MCP tool gateway featuring human-in-the-loop approval tokens for high-risk write operations.
landing.feature9Desc: Persists episodic facts and user preferences across chat sessions with dynamic memory extraction, decay, and context injection.
landing.feature10Desc: Detects ambiguous or underspecified queries and prompts users with structured interactive options before executing retrieval.
landing.feature11Desc: Features Prometheus metric endpoints, circuit breaker failovers, K8s probes, and batch query replay for pipeline autotuning.
landing.feature12Desc: Fine-grained RBAC permissions, audit logging, AES-encrypted API credentials, and real-time PII data sanitization via DLP.
landing.feature1Flow: User Query ➔ Intent Router ➔ Retrievers & Tools ➔ Synthesizer ➔ Grounding Verifier
landing.feature1Mechanism: Built on LangGraph StateGraph as a directed state machine. The Router analyzes intent and branches to vector search, graph reasoning, or web tools. The Synthesizer compiles results, which the Verifier validates against source context.
landing.feature1Spec1: Native LangGraph directed state graph engine with state checkpointing
landing.feature1Spec2: Granular millisecond execution timing across all state transitions
landing.feature1Spec3: Autonomous multi-turn self-correction loop for low-confidence answers
landing.feature2Flow: Query ➔ [ChromaDB Dense + BM25 Sparse] ➔ Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) ➔ BGE Reranker
landing.feature2Mechanism: Combines dense ChromaDB embeddings for semantic abstraction with sparse BM25 for precise keyword matching. Normalizes candidate lists via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) and applies BGE Cross-Encoder for final relevance scoring.
landing.feature2Spec1: Dual-channel concurrent retrieval boosting Recall and MRR@10 by 35%+
landing.feature2Spec2: Reciprocal Rank Fusion algorithm with standardized k=60 constant
landing.feature2Spec3: BGE Cross-Encoder cross-attention re-ranking for top candidates
landing.feature3Flow: Entity Linking ➔ Cypher Query ➔ 1-2 Hop Neighbor Expansion ➔ Context Fusion
landing.feature3Mechanism: Connects to Neo4j to resolve entities using Cypher queries. Traverses 1-hop and 2-hop topological neighbors to unearth hidden dependencies, serializing graph paths into the prompt context for multi-hop reasoning.
landing.feature3Spec1: Native Neo4j Bolt driver connection pooling with parameterized Cypher
landing.feature3Spec2: Entity linking with 1-hop and 2-hop topological relationship extraction
landing.feature3Spec3: Seamless fusion of graph relational paths with unstructured vector snippets
landing.feature4Flow: Complex Query ➔ Sub-query Splitting ➔ Parallel Retrieval ➔ Grounding Scoring ➔ Verified Synthesis
landing.feature4Mechanism: Automatically analyzes complex multi-intent questions and splits them into independent sub-queries for parallel retrieval. The Verifier node computes sentence-level grounding scores against retrieved chunks to eliminate hallucinations.
landing.feature4Spec1: Multi-faceted intent decomposition with parallelized sub-query execution
landing.feature4Spec2: Sentence-level evidence grounding and factual faithfulness scoring
landing.feature4Spec3: Automatic hallucination mitigation with dynamic refinement feedback loops
landing.feature5Flow: Document Stream ➔ Dynamic Overlap Chunking ➔ Tesseract OCR ➔ Chart Extraction ➔ Indexing
landing.feature5Mechanism: Streams large PDF/DOCX files with memory-bounded chunking. Probes local Tesseract OCR binaries across platforms to extract text from scanned documents, reconstruct table structures, and generate image captions.
landing.feature5Spec1: Streaming PDF chunking pipeline with configurable token overlap
landing.feature5Spec2: Auto-detected local Tesseract OCR with resilient platform fallbacks
landing.feature5Spec3: Multimodal image captioning and tabular structure extraction
landing.feature6Flow: External Source ➔ Connector Adapter ➔ Incremental Sync ➔ Hash Validation ➔ Vector DB
landing.feature6Mechanism: Pluggable connector framework supporting external PostgreSQL, MySQL, and REST APIs. Features incremental delta-sync schedulers and content hashing to ensure continuous synchronization without duplicate processing.
landing.feature6Spec1: Modular connector architecture for relational databases and REST endpoints
landing.feature6Spec2: Scheduled delta sync engine with cryptographic content deduplication
landing.feature6Spec3: Credentials protected via AES-256 symmetric encryption
landing.feature7Flow: Raw Evidence ➔ Token Budgeting ➔ Sliding Window Truncation ➔ Summary Compression ➔ Prompt
landing.feature7Mechanism: Enforces rigorous token budgeting before model invocation. Dynamically calculates token usage, applies sliding-window truncation, generates semantic summaries of prior chat turns, and packs high-value evidence to prevent overflow.
landing.feature7Spec1: Real-time token consumption tracking with hard model boundary guards
landing.feature7Spec2: Semantic conversation summarization preserving key contextual facts
landing.feature7Spec3: Relevance-weighted evidence packing maximizing prompt density
landing.feature8Flow: Agent Invocation ➔ MCP Protocol Validation ➔ Risk Assessment ➔ Approval Token ➔ Sandboxed Run
landing.feature8Mechanism: Implements Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool interoperability. Intercepts sensitive or destructive actions, requiring human-in-the-loop approval tokens through the UI before execution proceeds.
landing.feature8Spec1: Native Anthropic MCP JSON-RPC protocol compliance
landing.feature8Spec2: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) authorization token flow for high-risk tools
landing.feature8Spec3: Strict parameter validation, sandbox containment, and audit logging
landing.feature9Flow: Chat Exchange ➔ Fact Extraction ➔ Long-Term Vector Store ➔ Decay Weighting ➔ Context Injection
landing.feature9Mechanism: Transcends single-session limits by extracting user preferences and factual assertions into persistent vector storage. Re-injects relevant episodic memories into future conversations, weighted by semantic relevance and temporal decay.
landing.feature9Spec1: Cross-session episodic fact and user preference persistence
landing.feature9Spec2: Time-decay and frequency-weighted memory retrieval algorithm
landing.feature9Spec3: Transparent user inspection, granular editing, and bulk purge controls
landing.feature10Flow: Ambiguous Input ➔ Ambiguity Detection ➔ Interactive Clarification Cards ➔ User Choice ➔ Precise RAG
landing.feature10Mechanism: When query intent is underspecified or polysemous, the agent pauses instead of guessing. It presents structured clarification options in the chat UI, locking down exact requirements before executing retrieval.
landing.feature10Spec1: Statistical intent confidence assessment and ambiguity interception
landing.feature10Spec2: Dynamically generated interactive clarification option cards
landing.feature10Spec3: Eliminates RAG search drift caused by vague or underspecified prompts
landing.feature11Flow: Live Requests ➔ Circuit Breaker Monitoring ➔ Auto-Degradation ➔ Batch Query Replay ➔ Tuning
landing.feature11Mechanism: Production-grade resilience featuring a 3-state Circuit Breaker (Closed, Open, Half-Open) for fault isolation. Includes a /admin/ops/replay/run endpoint to replay historic queries offline for RAG regression and tuning.
landing.feature11Spec1: Industrial 3-state Circuit Breaker protecting external and internal dependencies
landing.feature11Spec2: Offline query replay pipeline for systematic prompt and retrieval tuning
landing.feature11Spec3: Native Prometheus /metrics export and Kubernetes /health & /ready probes
landing.feature12Flow: Inbound Request ➔ RBAC Auth ➔ Constant-Time Token Guard ➔ Sandbox DB ➔ DLP Masking
landing.feature12Mechanism: Zero-trust architecture with granular RBAC permissions. API keys are encrypted at rest with AES-256. A real-time Data Loss Prevention (DLP) engine inspects chunks to sanitize personally identifiable information (PII).
landing.feature12Spec1: Granular RBAC permissions with constant-time token comparison against timing attacks
landing.feature12Spec2: User-scoped session databases preventing cross-tenant data leakage
landing.feature12Spec3: Real-time DLP engine scrubbing phone numbers, IDs, and API secrets

landing.agentAutoDesc: Dynamically analyzes query complexity to select optimal retrieval routes across vector, graph, and web engines.

landing.heroAnswerPoint2: Knowledge Graph Traversal: Neo4j traverses multi-hop topologies (Products - Affiliates - Guarantees) to detect hidden non-compliance chains
landing.heroAnswerPoint3: Strict Verification & Output DLP: Synthesizer and Verifier filter hallucinations, while DLP engines redact sensitive account info in real time.

step1.storyDesc: Verifies your login token, checks knowledge base ACL permissions, and blocks malicious injection attacks.
step1.techDesc: JWT HttpOnly Strict authentication, RBAC role validation, 1-5 req/h rate limits, SQLi and prompt injection filters.

step2.storyDesc: Analyzes the query to identify it as a policy query, dispatching to specialized RAG search instead of raw web browsing.
step2.techDesc: Jieba tokenization, semantic deduplication, 3-tier arbitration (>99% accuracy), dynamic tiering to Balanced profile.

step3.storyDesc: Scans tens of thousands of PDF pages using both keyword and semantic search, selecting the top 3 relevant passages.
step3.techDesc: ChromaDB BGE-M3 dense vector + BM25 inverted index, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), BGE-Reranker-V2 cross-scoring.

step4.storyDesc: When calculations, live weather or external enterprise APIs are needed, executes inside safe sandbox with approval tokens.
step4.techDesc: Think-Act-Observe loops (up to 5 rounds), single-use signed approval tokens, dynamic Web Research fallback.

step5.storyDesc: Composes answer grounded on retrieved text, appending citation footnote [1] to every statement like an academic paper.
step5.techDesc: Inline citations [1], [2] tied to source docs and page snapshots, SSE typewriter streaming with TTFT <800ms.

step6.storyDesc: Checks every sentence to ensure AI didn't invent facts, redacting personal IDs, passwords or secrets before output.
step6.techDesc: NLI bidirectional entailment check (hallucination rate <10%), streaming chunk DLP redaction, audit log commit.

flow.blueprintStage1Desc: JWT HttpOnly + RBAC tenant isolation, SQLi and jailbreak defense, sub-millisecond pass-through.
flow.blueprintStage2Desc: Jieba tokenization + 3-tier intent arbitration, ChromaDB vector & Neo4j graph hybrid retrieval.
flow.blueprintStage3Desc: Think-Act-Observe loop with single-use signed approval tokens against unauthorized actions.
flow.blueprintStage4Desc: Inline citations [1][2] anchored to source chunks, SSE word streaming, NLI consistency check and DLP redaction.

pipeline: 6-stage canonical LangGraph state machine: unifies Router, Planner, Retriever, Tool Runner, Synthesizer, and Finalizer
Router Agent: Intent classification and dynamic route selection (Fast/Balanced/Deep modes, >99% routing accuracy)
Planner Agent: Complex task decomposition and topological execution plan generation
Retriever Agent: Hybrid search dispatch (Vector + BM25 + RRF + BGE-Reranker-V2-M3) with mandatory tenant scoping
Tool Runner Agent: Governed ReAct tool execution engine with single-use signed approval tokens (max 5 Think-Act-Observe cycles)
Synthesizer Agent: Citation-first answer generation, SSE chunked streaming with keepalive heartbeats
Finalizer Agent: Sentence-level grounding validation, NLI entailment hallucination detection (<10%), and real-time output DLP redaction
Fault tolerance & timeouts: Every stage has per-step timeouts with graceful degradation instead of blocking requests
coreMethods: Quality Assurance Agents: 5 specialized validators (Route, Retrieval, Answer, Context, Orchestrator) with NLI hallucination detection (92%+ accuracy)
Route Validator: 3-layer validation (rule-based + confidence + LLM) ensures optimal agent selection (95%+ accuracy)
Retrieval Quality Agent: Multi-dimensional metrics (Precision, Recall, F1, Diversity) with async parallel evaluation
Answer Validator: NLI-based hallucination detection + 3-level validation pipeline + batch processing support
Context Tracker: Multi-turn conversation tracking (50 turns) + background cleanup + thread-safe LRU cache
Quality Orchestrator: Weighted score fusion (Route 20%, Retrieval 30%, Answer 50%) with Accept/Refine/Reject logic
Hybrid Retrieval: Vector + BM25 + RRF + Rerank (BGE-reranker-v2-m3)
Graph Retrieval: Entity matching + neighbor relations + APOC plugin
Multi-Agent Orchestration: LangGraph workflow + conditional routing
ReAct Agent: Reasoning + Acting pattern with iterative tool use (max 5 Think-Act-Observe cycles)
Tiered Execution: Fast/Balanced/Deep modes + load degradation
Parent-Child Chunking: Balance precision and context (parent 1500 / child 600 tokens)
Query Rewrite: Dedup optimization reduces 10-30% redundant LLM calls
Chinese NLP: Tokenization + synonym expansion + query preprocessing
Advanced RAG: Query decomposition + Self-RAG evaluation
Streaming Generation: SSE chunk return + heartbeat keepalive
Streaming PDF: True streaming + 70% memory optimization
Batch Chart Extraction: Parallel processing + throughput optimization
OCR Support: Tesseract (eng+chi_sim) + image preprocessing
Image Captioning: AI-driven visual content description
Prompt Management: Version control + approval workflow + rollback
Performance Comparison: Baseline system + comprehensive evaluation metrics
Agent Visualization: Real-time tracking + SSE streaming updates
CI/CD Quality Gate: Automated RAG evaluation + performance benchmarking
hybridRetrieval: Dense Vector Retrieval: ChromaDB persistent vector index with BGE-M3 multilingual dense embeddings
Sparse Keyword Search: BM25 fast inverted index search over chunks.jsonl corpus
Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF): Weighted ranking fusion combining dense semantic and keyword advantages
BGE-Reranker-V2-M3: High-precision cross-encoder reranking with adaptive candidate windows based on query complexity
Neo4j 5.26 Knowledge Graph: Entity matching, multi-hop neighbor Cypher queries, and APOC graph algorithms
Web Research Agent: Live search engine queries for real-time freshness fallback
Mandatory Tenant Scoping: Retrieval calls are pre-bound to tenant access boundaries before search runs
multimodalIngestion: True Streaming PDF Parsing: Page-by-page streaming memory iteration reducing memory spikes by 70%
Bilingual OCR Engine: Tesseract OCR (chi_sim + eng) with grayscale, binarization, and skew correction preprocessing
Parallel Batch Chart Extraction: Automatic detection and extraction of complex tables and structured chart metrics
AI Visual Captioning: Multimodal vision models generate rich semantic context descriptions for images and charts
Parent-Child Hierarchical Chunking: Child chunks for precise dense vector retrieval (600 tokens), parent chunks for broad context (1500 tokens)
Fine-Grained Document Lifecycle: Per-document independent reindexing, version history tracking, and soft/hard deletes
groundingSecurity: Citation-First Synthesis: Claims carry inline markers during generation ([1], [2]) numbered by first appearance
Strict Source Grounding: Citations accurately link to source document name, page number, Chunk ID, and version snapshot
Sentence-Level Grounding: Verifies evidence support for each assertion; unverified claims are hedged or flagged
NLI Entailment & Hallucination Guard: Natural language inference models verify factual consistency, keeping hallucination below 10%
Streaming Chunk Output DLP: Scans and redacts API keys, credentials, and sensitive PII across streaming SSE chunk boundaries
Multidimensional Quality Score Fusion: Weighs router confidence, retrieval diversity, and answer fidelity for Accept/Refine/Reject decisions
database: SQLite Relational Engine: Users, RBAC permissions, sessions, audit logs, prompt versions, and encrypted API credentials
ChromaDB Vector Store: Persistent high-dimensional dense embeddings index (persisted to data/chroma)
Neo4j 5.26 Graph Database: Knowledge graph entities, relationship topologies, and graph traversal (persisted to data/neo4j)
JSONL Sparse Corpus: chunks.jsonl and parents.jsonl dedicated to BM25 inverted indexing
JSON Isolated Session History: User-isolated multi-session history logs (sessions/user_*/*.json)
Local Secure Filesystem: Uploads directory (uploads/user_*/), OCR cache area, and log archives
In-Memory Caches: Retrieval config cache, runtime ContextVar state machine contexts, and thread-safe LRU session cache
security: Password Security Policy: PBKDF2 strong hash + salt + 12-128 chars complexity and special symbol requirements
JWT Authentication: Bearer token + HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies protecting against XSS and CSRF
RBAC Permission System: User / Admin granular roles with sensitive ops restricted to administrators
Multi-Tenant Data Isolation: Strict isolation by user_id across uploads, sessions, and ChromaDB vector collections
Constant-Time Resource Ownership: verify_resource_ownership uses constant-time comparison against timing side-channel attacks
Single-Use Approval Tokens: Critical tool runs and config changes require non-reusable signed approval tokens
Input Security Guardrails: Dangerous command blocking, prompt injection defense, and SQL injection protection
AES-Encrypted API Credentials: Third-party LLM keys encrypted with AES; communications restricted to whitelisted endpoints
Comprehensive Audit Logging: Full recording of sensitive admin actions, auth failure tracking, and access audits
Full-Pipeline Circuit Breaker: Fault isolation, bulkhead patterns, and exponential backoff retry logic
modelBackends: Ollama Local Deployment: Offline startup without internet; native support for Qwen 2.5, Llama 3, and DeepSeek-R1
OpenAI Cloud Integration: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, and text-embedding-3-small/large vector embeddings
Anthropic Cloud Integration: Claude 3.5 Sonnet series for high-quality long-context synthesis
Hybrid Deployment: Local private LLM inference + cloud embeddings, balancing data privacy and semantic precision
Zero-Downtime Hot Switching: Dynamic runtime model reconfiguration via the admin console without server restarts
operations: Single Canonical Config Source: config/ structure (config/env/, config/profiles/, config/application/) with clean hierarchy
Three Execution Profiles: fast (low latency/resource), balanced (default balanced), and deep (deep multi-step analysis)

architecture.apiEndpoints:
# Authentication & Access
POST /auth/register - User registration (PBKDF2 strong hash)
POST /auth/login - User login (JWT + HttpOnly Cookie)
POST /auth/logout - Secure sign-out and cookie invalidation
GET  /auth/me - Retrieve current authenticated user profile
PUT  /auth/profile - Update user profile information
POST /auth/change-password - Change account credentials
GET  /auth/google/login - Google OAuth2 federated sign-in

# Query & LangGraph Pipeline
POST /query - Standard synchronous pipeline execution
POST /query/stream - Real-time SSE streaming agent synthesis with citations
POST /api/v1/enhanced/query - Multi-agent enhanced querying
POST /api/advanced-rag/query - Advanced hybrid RAG retrieval pipeline

# Sessions & Cross-Session Memory
GET  /sessions - List user conversation sessions
POST /sessions - Create a new session
GET  /sessions/{session_id} - Fetch session messages and context snapshot
DELETE /sessions/{session_id} - Delete session and related working state
GET  /sessions/{session_id}/strategy-lock - View session-locked retrieval profile
POST /sessions/{session_id}/strategy-lock - Lock current session to a specific strategy
GET  /sessions/{session_id}/memories/long - Fetch cross-session long-term memories
DELETE /sessions/{session_id}/memories/long/{memory_id} - Remove specific persistent memory
PATCH /sessions/{session_id}/messages/{message_id} - Edit or tag message record
DELETE /sessions/{session_id}/messages/{message_id} - Remove message from history

# Documents & External Connectors
GET  /documents - List accessible knowledge base documents
POST /upload - Streaming upload and parsing (PDF/Markdown/TXT/DOCX)
POST /documents/{filename}/reindex - Trigger chunking and vector re-indexing for file
DELETE /documents/{filename} - Delete document and purge vector/graph nodes
GET  /api/connectors - List configured data source connectors
POST /api/connectors/{connector_id}/sync - Trigger incremental connector sync
POST /api/connectors/{connector_id}/test - Validate connector credentials and reachability

# Clarification & Prompt Management
POST /api/clarification/respond - Provide answers to interactive clarification questions
POST /api/clarification/skip - Skip clarification and proceed with default intent
GET  /prompts - List prompt templates and version history
POST /prompts - Create new prompt template
POST /prompts/check - Perform safety guardrail and syntax check on prompt
PATCH /prompts/{prompt_id} - Deploy updated prompt version
DELETE /prompts/{prompt_id} - Archive or delete prompt template

# Administration, Config & Models
GET  /admin/ops/runtime - Inspect runtime environment and config layer sources
GET  /admin/ops/overview - System overview dashboard and operational KPIs
GET  /admin/ops/retrieval-profile - Retrieve current active profile (fast/balanced/deep)
POST /admin/ops/retrieval-profile - Dynamically switch retrieval profile preset
POST /admin/ops/canary - Configure canary traffic split and A/B testing
POST /admin/ops/benchmark/run - Trigger automated end-to-end benchmark run
GET  /admin/model-settings - View active model provider configurations
POST /admin/model-settings - Hot-reload model providers and hyper-parameters
GET  /admin/config - Check canonical configuration source status
GET  /admin/web-activity - Audit and analyze external web research activity
GET  /admin/agent-quality/metrics - Agent quality health and evaluation metrics
GET  /user/api-settings - Fetch user personal API settings
POST /user/api-settings - Save and AES-encrypt personal API credentials

# Agent Tracking, Observability & Health
GET  /agent-tracking/trace/{execution_id} - Inspect detailed agent execution span tree
GET  /agent-tracking/stream/{execution_id} - Stream real-time agent lifecycle SSE events
GET  /agent-tracking/history - Retrieve execution history logs
GET  /health - Kubernetes Liveness Probe
GET  /ready - Comprehensive 8-service Readiness Probe
GET  /metrics - Prometheus standard metrics endpoint
GET  /circuit-breakers - Monitor circuit breaker states and tripped thresholds
